# Ease Language Reference (1-Page LLM Guide)

Ease is a small, strict, bracket-free language implemented in Go.
Every construct has **one canonical form** and **zero silent fallbacks**.

## 1. Core Invariants
- **No `bool`, no `true`/`false`, no truthiness, no flag pollution**: Conditions (`x > 0`, `a is b`, `contains txt_or_list item`, `and`, `or`, `not`) live only in `check`, `where`, and `test` (no `if`, no `check raw as number` -> use `n = raw as number or 0` + `check n > 0`). Conditions cannot be stored/printed/passed/returned (`TypeError`). Model outcomes/states as **domain properties** (`state = "free" | "occupied"`, `style = "solid" | "outline"`), never `0`/`1` flags or `"yes" | "no"` pseudo-booleans; exit `loop` directly via `-> end` instead of `running = 1`. Text boundaries (source, `ask`, `network:fetch`, `as json`) reject invalid UTF-8 and normalize to NFC.
- **Two `check` forms, strict value discipline & arrow law (`->` = value return or `-> end`)**:
  - `-> <expr>` returns a value from `to` or `swarm loop` (multi-line `to` without `->` is a non-empty `void` procedure, like `say`, `put`, `close`, `save`, `synth:play`, `screen:open`, `network:reply_*`, `network:tcp_send`; no implicit returns, no empty `void` procs). One-liner: `to add a b -> a + b`. Expression after `->` **must start on the same line** (`cond ->\n val` is `SyntaxError`). Statements/side effects after `->` and top-level `-> <value>` are forbidden (`-> end` only in `loop`/`take`). Standalone pure expressions, discarded non-`void` call returns, and unused locals in `to`/`swarm loop` are static `TypeError`s (`fail` is removed).
  - 2 `check` forms only (bare `check\n` verdict table & `else ->` are removed): (1) `check <cond> -> <value | end>` (single-line exit guard); (2) `check <cond>\n  stmts...\n  [else\n  stmts...]\nend` (multi-line block; `-> end` or `-> <expr>` may sit on its own line inside). End non-union multi-guard returns with a final `-> <fallback>` line (`check it < 0 -> "neg"` / `check it is 0 -> "zero"` / `-> "pos"`).
- **Pattern matching (`match ... end`)**: Matches full strings against `"..."` templates with `{...}` wildcards, `{name}` (`0+` runes, minimal left-to-right), `{name: N}` fixed rune widths (`N >= 1`), and `{name as number|<Union>}` typed captures (`'...'` raw literal; repeated `{tag}` enforces equality). Statement `match <text> ... end` supports value/exit arms (`"pat" -> <value | end>`), effect arms (`"pat"\n  stmts...`, no `->`), and `else -> ...` or `else\n  stmts...`. Expression `match` requires `else` on `text` (multi-line `else` must end with explicit `-> <expr>`); on `list<text>` (`it`, `it.index`) `else` is optional (sieve semantics; return via `-> match lines ... end`).
- **1-based positions & unified `loop` / `swarm loop`**: All positional indexing (`xs.1`, `xs.(expr)`, `"abc".1`, CSV `row.1`, `xs with .1 = v`), `it.index`, and `slice` are **1-based (`1..N`)**. Literal `.0` (`xs.0`, `xs with .0 = v`) is a `SyntaxError`; dynamic `idx < 1` or `idx > len` is a `RuntimeError`. (`range start end` stays inclusive on any integers, e.g. `range 0 5` or `range -2 2`.)
- **Scoping & shadowing**: Function parameters and locals **may** shadow global variables/constants (but **not** `to` functions, built-ins, or module aliases). Globals are read-only inside `to` functions ("Assigned-in-Function = Local"; reading a global *before* assigning a local of the same name fails with `Cannot modify global '...' inside a function...`). Parameters are immutable read-only inputs (reassigning a parameter is a static `TypeError`; bind a new local like `cur = x` instead). `loop` and `take` read/update enclosing locals (`total = total + it`), while newly created variables stay block-local. `loop ... end` is a statement (no `for`, `repeat`, `in`, `continue`): without an iterable it loops indefinitely (`it.index` `1, 2, ...`, requires `-> end` or early return); `loop <list|range> ... end` binds `it` and 1-based `it.index` (`def` fields cannot be named `index`, while `number`/`text`/`list` are valid field names like `seat.number`, `msg.text`).
- **Data-parallel `swarm loop <iterable> ... end`**: Runs a bounded worker pool over `list` or `range start end`, returning a `1..N` ordered homogeneous `list` via `-> <expr>` (or `void` in statement position when no `->` is used). Outer locals are strictly read-only (`isWorkerRoot`), shared lists are frozen, `say` buffers flush in `1..N` order, `ask`, `spawn` (direct or transitive), and direct `-> end` are forbidden, and errors report the smallest failing `it.index`. Wrap `(swarm loop ... end)` in `(...)` as a call arg or before `where`.
- **Background workers & typed inboxes (`spawn`, `inbox as <type>`, `put`, `take`, `close`)**: No `async`/`await` or shared mutable state. `ch = inbox as <type>` creates a buffered (64) channel (`text`, `number`, `def` record, or union; no `bool`/`csv`/`bytes`). `spawn fn arg1 arg2` (or `spawn mod:fn ...`) launches a worker with frozen args/outer state. `put ch val` blocks once 64 unread items are buffered (so >64 puts on the same thread without a `spawn` consumer deadlocks; putting to closed raises `RuntimeError`). `close ch` closes idempotently; `take ch ... end` consumes FIFO (`it`, `it.index`, exits when closed & drained or via `check <cond> -> end`). Root waits for workers on exit.
- **Prefix calls & naming (`def` / `to`, no commas)**: `def` = noun blueprint (`def ErrorMessage`), `to` = English infinitive verb (`to process_response res`). No commas in signatures or calls (`to add a b`, `add 2 3`); commas are only for `list 10, 25, 40` and single-line `with`. Function/built-in names cannot collide across program, variables, params, or imported modules.
- **Asymmetric `is` / `is not` (no `==`, `!=`, `is-not` in source)**: `"is-not"` appears only in `ease ast --json`. `<value> is <type>` checks membership; `<value> is <value>` checks equality. Types are forbidden on the left (`user is a` -> `TypeError`). Invalid union-literal comparisons (`d.answer is "yse"`) raise static `TypeError`. Nested `def` record defaults instantiate immediately.
- **Top-down domain hierarchies & orthogonal unions (`def U = A | B | ...`)**:
  - `def` records and unions can be declared in **any order** (top-down whole-to-part, e.g. `Hall` -> `rows = list as Row` -> `chairs = list as Chair` via `hall.rows.(r).chairs.(c)` — prefer domain records over flat `(r - 1) * width + c` arrays). `def` with `|` creates a union (no 1-variant unions); without `|`, `def X = val` is a constant. Model fallible operations with **outcome unions** (`def BookingOutcome = Hall | BookingRejected`), never `{status = "ok" | "err", data = ...}` wrapper structs.
  - **4 building blocks**: literals (`"OK"`, `404`), `text`/`number`, `def` records, and named unions (flattened automatically; usable as field types and `list as <union>`). **3 guardrails**: no redundant literals with `text`/`number`, no duplicates, and records in the same union must differ in a mandatory field/type/disjoint constraint.
  - **Narrowing & exhaustiveness**: `check res is ErrorMessage -> ...` narrows `res` inside the branch; exiting guards (Form 1 or exiting Form 2 without `else`) subtract handled variants sequentially (enabling rest-narrowing to the sole remaining record/scalar and completing exhaustive union functions without a dummy trailing `->`). Partial union checks without a final `-> ...` fail with `Non-exhaustive check`.
  - **JSON, CSV & `as` contracts**: Two-step cast required: raw `text` **must** go through `m = raw as json` (`true`/`false` -> `"true"`/`"false"`) or `rows = raw as csv` (requires header row for `it as <def>`) into a local *before* `m as <def_or_union>` (raw `text as <def>` fails!). `<rec|list|map> as json` / `<flat_rec_or_map_list> as csv` serialize back. `as text` works only on `text`/`number`. Chained `as` (`x as A as B`, `x as A or y as B`) is forbidden. `<map_or_rec> as <def_or_union>` validates all mandatory fields (`TypeError` on `Missing field '...'`). Defaults live in `<def> with ...`.
  - **Fallbacks (`<expr> as <type> or <fallback>`)**: Allowed for `number`, `text`, and scalar unions (`"404" as HttpCode or 200`). Evaluates `<fallback>` lazily (memoized in batch casts like `lines as number or 0`) and requires static AOT type match to `<type>`/`<union>`. Forbidden on `def` records, record unions, `json`, `csv`, `bytes`, and `load ... as ...`.

## 2. Operators, Precedence, Escapes & Cheat Sheet
- **Precedence (high -> low)**:
  1. `()`, `.` field/index (`xs.1`, `xs.(expr)`), `:` module qualifier (`mod:fn`), `with`
  2. Prefix calls (`fn a b`, `mod:fn a b` — args parse as `unary`; `say mod:fn a` needs no outer parens, wrap only compound call args: `add (1 + 2) 3`, `append lines (mod:fn a)`)
  3. Postfix `where <cond>` and `as <type> [or <fallback>]` (bind to whole call result: `ask "Port?" as number or 8080`; `or` fallback parses as `unary`, so wrap compounds: `x as text or ("a" + "b")`), unary `-x` (`-2` no space = literal `f -2`; `a - 2` = subtraction)
  4. `*`, `/` (float division: `7 / 2` is `3.5`), `%` (modulo on `number` & numeric lists, floats allowed, sign follows dividend: `-5 % 3` is `-2`)
  5. `+` (strict `number + number`, `text + text`, or numeric lists — never mixes types; use `"{a}{b}"` or `as text`), `-`
  6. `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `is`, `is not` (conditions only in `check` / `where` / `test`)
  7. `not`, then `and`, then `or`
- **String literals**: `"..."` interpolates atomic `text`/`number` via `{expr}` and supports **only** `\n`, `\r`, `\t`, `\"`, `\\`, `\{`, `\}` escapes (unknown escapes -> `SyntaxError`); `'...'` is raw 1:1 with zero interpolation or escapes.

```ease
import network

def pi = 3.14
def status = "OK" | "FAILED"
def ErrorMessage
    code    = 500
    message = "Unknown error"
end
def outcome = status | ErrorMessage
def user
    id   = 0
    name = "Guest"
    role = "guest" | "admin"
end

to process_response res
    check res is "OK"         -> "Processed successfully"
    check res is "FAILED"     -> "Unknown failure"
    check res is ErrorMessage -> "Error {res.code}: {res.message}"
end

to collect_even_mods xs
    kept = list as number
    loop xs
        check it % 2 is 0
            kept = append kept (floor (it / 2))
        end
    end
    -> kept
end

to parse_port raw
    match raw
        "PORT={p as number}"
            check p < 1 or p > 65535 -> 0
            -> p
        else -> 0
    end
end

to add a b -> a + b

ada = user with id = 1, name = "Aria", role = "admin"
nums = list 10, 20, 30
idx = 2
updated = nums with .1 = 99
loop range 1 3
    check it > 2 -> end
    say "{it.index}: {add it 10}"
end
users = list as user with
    id = 1, name = "Aria"
    id = 2, name = "Bram", role = "admin"
end
promoted = users with role = "admin"
raw_map = '{"id": 7, "name": "Guest", "role": "admin"}' as json
parsed = raw_map as user
err_map = '{"code": 503, "message": "Unavailable"}' as json
raw_err = err_map as outcome

test "example"
    add 2 3 is 5
    (15 % 7) is 1
    nums.1 is 10
    nums.(idx) is 20
    updated is list 99, 20, 30
    slice nums 1 2 is list 10, 20
    promoted.1.role is "admin"
    parsed.id is 7
    collect_even_mods (list 3, 4, 7, 8) is list 2, 4
    parse_port "PORT=8080" is 8080
    parse_port "PORT=99999" is 0
    ("abc" as number or 0) is 0
    ("WARN" as status or "OK") is "OK"
    (swarm loop range 1 3
        -> it * 10
    end) is list 10, 20, 30
    box = inbox as number
    put box 7
    close box
    take box
        it is 7
    end
    process_response "OK" is "Processed successfully"
    process_response raw_err is "Error 503: Unavailable"
    "abc" as number is error
    '{"id": 7, "name": "Guest", "role": "admin"}' as user is error
    missing_name = '{"id": 7, "role": "admin"}' as json
    missing_name as user ->
        error.type is "TypeError"
        error.message is "Missing field 'user.name'"
    end
    (ada with id = "bad") is error
    (user is ada) is error
end
```

## 3. Built-in Verbs, Modules & CLI
- **I/O & Control**: `say val` *(void, appends `\n`)*, `ask prompt` *(returns `text`; `RuntimeError` on EOF, skipped on EOF in `ease test`/`--ci`)*, `type val` *(returns `text`)*, `fields rec_or_map` *(returns `list<text>`)* (`fail` removed)
  - **Math**: `abs n`, `floor n`, `round n`, `min a b`, `max a b` (**no** `ceil` or `mod` verb — use `-floor (-x)` or `%`)
  - **Text & Lists**: `count list_or_text` (runes for `text`), `range start end` (inclusive, empty if `start > end`), `append xs item_or_list` (returns new list), `slice list_or_text start end` (1-based, both bounds inclusive, runes for `text`, clamps bounds to `1..len`, empty if out of order), `split txt sep`, `join text_list sep`, `trim txt`, `upper txt`, `lower txt`, `replace txt old new` (`old` != `""`), `contains txt_or_list item` (condition on `text` or atomic `list`), `sum num_list`, `avg num_list` (errors if empty), `sort num_or_text_list`
  - **Formats & Files**: `<val_or_txt> as json` / `as csv`, `load path [as text|json|csv|bytes]` (50 MB max; `csv` -> `list<map>` with `it.1` / `it.("Col")` / `it as <def>`; `bytes` -> `0..255` list), `save path data [as text|json|csv|bytes]` (`void` statement; `as <format>` required for non-`text`; `as bytes` valid only with `load`/`save`)
  - **Inbox (void statements!)**: `put box val`, `close box` (like `synth:play`, pure statements with no return value — never assign or pass as values!)
- **Lists, vectors, `where`, record/batch/index `with`**: Numeric lists support element-wise `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `%` and scalar broadcasting (`prices * 1.19 + shipping`). `<list> where <cond>` (single-line or `where ... end` block with union narrowing on `it`) filters; `<rec> with field = val` (no dot) updates a record, `<list> with field = expr` updates records uniformly (`it`, `it.index` `1..N`), and `<list> with .1 = val` (dot, or `.(expr)`) updates 1-based list elements.
- **Tests (`test "label" ... end`)**: Write assertions directly without `check` (`add 2 3 is 5`); every non-`void` expression line must be an assertion (assign `res = fn ...` to discard a return value, else `got <type> instead of condition`). Supports assignments, `loop`, `check <cond> ... end` for conditional setup/narrowing, `is` / `is not` (`res is MyRec` narrows `res`), `expr is error` / `expr is not error`, and `expr -> error.type is "..." / error.message is "..." end`.
- **Limits**: `maxListSize = 1_000_000` (`range`, `append`, `split`), `maxHTTPBodyBytes = 10 MB`, `maxCallDepth = 256`, `defaultInboxCapacity = 64`, `load` max `50 MB`.
- **File modules & Standard library (`import network`, `screen`, `random`, `synth`, `system`)**: `import "./file.ease" as mod` (relative paths only; `mod:verb`, `mod.def` / `mod.const`; module `test` blocks skipped). Internal `std/` primitives (`http_call`, `net_*`, `screen_open`, `screen_present`, `rand_*`, `synth_play`, `sys_*`) are private and rejected in user code:
  - `network`: `network.network` (`url, timeout, token`), `network:fetch target path`, `network:send target path payload`, `inbox`-driven servers (`network.http_request` (`id, method, url, path, body, remote, token, timeout`), `network.tcp_client` (`id, remote, lines`), `network:serve_http port requests`, `void`: `network:reply_text req status body`, `network:reply_json req status data`, `network:serve_tcp port clients`, `void`: `network:tcp_send client msg`; `--ci` returns port `0`).
  - `screen`: `screen.fps_mode` (`number | "unlimited"`), `screen.screen` (`title, width, height, fps`), `screen.scene` (`background, boxes, circles, lines, triangles, labels, shapes`), `screen.box` (`x, y, width, height, color`), `screen.label` (`x, y, content, size, color`), `screen.event` (`"close" | "key" | "click" | "move"`), `screen:open win events` (`void`), `screen:present win current_scene` (JSON `screen.frame_state`; headless emits `key`, `click`, `close` and closes `events` after 3 frames).
  - `random`: `random:roll low high` (inclusive int), `random:pick items` (non-empty `list`), `random:shuffle items` (immutable copy).
  - `synth`: `synth.wave_kind` (`"triangle" | "square" | "sine"`), `synth.melody` (`notes = list as text` like `"E4/8"`, `"C#5/4"`, `"Bb3/4"`, `"REST/8"`, `bpm = 120`, `wave = wave_kind`), `synth:play m` (void, synchronous; use `spawn synth:play ...` for polyphony/chords or non-blocking game SFX; headless validates & renders without audio device).
  - `system`: `system.arguments` (1-based `list<text>` of CLI args after `<file>` / `--`; empty in `ease test` / `--ci`), `system.ok` (`0`), `system:exit reason` (`void`; `0..255` exit code or non-empty `text` error to `stderr` with exit `1`), `system.command` (`program`, `args`, `dir`, `timeout = 30`, `max_mb = 10` in `(0..512]` rolling RAM window), `system.process_report` (`code`, `stdout`, `stderr`), `system:run cmd` (direct exec without shell; non-zero exit returns `process_report`; OS/timeout errors raise `RuntimeError`).
- **CLI**: `ease <file>` (shorthand for `run`), `ease run <file> [--json] [--ci] [--trace]` (`--ci` runs `test` blocks then headless program; `ask` exits cleanly on EOF), `ease serve <file> [--port <n>] [--watch] [--debug] [--debug-port <n>] [--json]`, `ease check <file> [--json]`, `ease test <file> [--json] [--verbose] [--trace]`, `ease build <file> [-o out]`, `ease ast <file> [--json]`, `ease tokens <file>`, `ease repl`, `ease lsp`, `ease version` (`--version`, `-v`)
